name: Pinnacle Security Full-Body Riot Suit
description:
A modular riot-control suit with overlapping hard-shell plates covering the torso, arms, legs, and groin. Each plate is rated for blunt impact, low-velocity projectiles, and incendiary splash. The suit's interior is flame-retardant and incorporates cooling channels to manage heat buildup during extended deployments.

The visual presence of the Full-Body Riot Suit is itself a tool of crowd control — a line of officers in full riot kit communicates a level of force commitment that frequently de-escalates situations before physical contact occurs. When it doesn't, the suit earns its cost.
functionality: Full-body impact protection, incendiary resistance, extended-deployment cooling
what_it_says: You're the line, and everything behind you depends on you not moving.
story_hooks: A Full-Body Riot Suit is found abandoned in a residential district with all its plates removed — someone stripped the armor components for a purpose unrelated to crowd control.
